claims.object_text: DNA repair in both single and double strand break repair systems
claims.quote: Polynucleotide kinase 3'-phosphatase (PNKP) is an enzyme that is actively involved in DNA repair in both single and double strand break repair systems.

claims.object_text: a complex group of diseases with a broad clinical spectrum
claims.quote: Mutations in this protein or others in the same pathway are responsible for a complex group of diseases with a broad clinical spectrum.
As models, we analyze PNKP-related disorders, focusing on Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease and ataxia.
